lines.en: So I mean to tell you I want to take you out for lunch for your last day.
What do you think? Tomorrow? Lunch? You and me?
Wow, so that's it, huh? Just four o'clock and you are gone for good.
Am I doing the wrong thing?
It's just that sometimes goodbyes are a bitch.
You know what I think we should do?
I think we should just say the goodbyes for tomorrow.
And then tomorrow I can tell you what a great boss you turned out to be.
Listen, Michael, I really, I did text Pam, but.
I'll see you tomorrow at lunch.
I am looking forward to lunch.
